record.narrative:
I assessed the 12 new discovery results as an unadjusted Welch comparison panel with adequate cell sizes and signed estimates aligned to the registered positive direction. Positive estimates would indicate a clinically meaningful stronger-dependency difference in the exposed group relative to the comparator. Approximate 10% absolute-mean thresholds are about +0.0093 for outcome_014, +0.0175 for outcome_006, and +0.0248 for outcome_012.

H126 (feature_050 on outcome_006) and H127 (feature_050 on outcome_012) are both far below their outcome-specific thresholds. H127 upper confidence limit only barely crosses the outcome_012 threshold, while the point estimate is trivial, and this does not cohere with prior feature_050 evidence: outcome_002 validation collapsed toward null, and the prior outcome_014 result was imprecise. These claims remain formally unresolved because their upper bounds still include threshold-relevant positive values, but the feature_050 line is closed as not scientifically promising.

H128 (feature_064 on outcome_006) is subthreshold despite a positive sign, and H129 (feature_064 on outcome_012) is negative for the registered direction with an upper bound below threshold, so H129 is rejected. Together these fail to replicate the earlier imprecise outcome_014 signal for feature_064; the line is closed.

H130 and H131 (feature_055 levels on outcome_014) are below threshold and imprecise. H132 (feature_055 level_001 vs level_003 on outcome_006) has a threshold-exceeding point estimate, but its interval includes null/negative values and is wide. H133 (level_002 vs level_003 on outcome_006) is negative for the registered direction, with only the upper bound crossing threshold. Given that feature_055 does not show a coherent cross-outcome pattern and prior outcome_012/outcome_005 feature_055 evidence was subthreshold or against threshold-positive inference, I do not accept or validate these results.

H134 and H135 test feature_052. H134 is subthreshold on outcome_014; H135 is opposite to the registered direction on outcome_012 with an upper bound below threshold, so H135 is rejected. The feature_052 line lacks supporting coherence and is closed.

H136 (feature_065 on outcome_014) is the strongest remaining lead: the point estimate exceeds the outcome_014 threshold. However, its interval includes zero/negative values and much smaller effects, and the only adjacent tested feature_065 outcome_012 estimate (H137) is subthreshold. Feature_065 also has prior discordant evidence on outcome_001 and essentially null/reject evidence on outcome_004. Because this is a single wide-interval result among many correlated outcomes and prior borderline validation candidates have generally failed, I judge it insufficiently supported for independent validation at this stage. H136 therefore remains unresolved but closed, and H137 is closed as well.

No validation is requested. The overall conclusion remains that this supplied dataset does not currently support any accepted, clinically meaningful predictor association. These are dataset-specific association assessments only; they do not establish causality or generalizability.

record.narrative:
No new validation evidence or response deadline was delivered in this synthesis cycle. The accepted set remains empty. The supported scientific conclusion is therefore limited to this supplied dataset: most measured binary/categorical predictors show no clinically meaningful association with the CRISPR dependency outcomes, and earlier borderline validated or subgroup leads have not produced robust replication.

The strongest remaining lead is still H136, feature_065 = 1 versus 0 on outcome_014. Its signed point estimate (+0.0319) exceeds the approximately 10% clinical threshold for outcome_014 (~0.0093), but the 95% discovery interval (-0.0074 to +0.0711) includes null and much smaller effects. H137 on outcome_012 is in the same signed direction but is subthreshold (+0.0169; threshold ~0.0248) and imprecise (-0.0027 to +0.0365). Prior feature_065 evidence is not strongly corroborative: H19 on outcome_001 was opposite to its registered positive direction, and H32 on outcome_004 was null with an upper bound below threshold. Because a single wide threshold-exceeding point estimate has repeatedly not survived adjacent-outcome or independent testing in this run, I do not accept H136 and do not request validation now.

However, H136 is the best candidate for one focused coherence check before closing the feature_065 line permanently. I registered adjacent feature_065 tests on outcome_006, outcome_015, and outcome_003. Outcome_006 has a low clinical threshold, while outcome_015 and outcome_003 have lower outcome variability and therefore better precision for threshold-level effects. The decision rule is strict: if feature_065 shows a threshold-exceeding signed effect on at least two of these adjacent outcomes, preferably with intervals substantially excluding null/negative effects, then validation would be justified. If not, close the feature_065 line as likely screening noise or outcome-specific instability.

For broad coverage, I also registered feature_042 on outcome_010 and feature_045 on outcome_015. These are reasonably balanced binary contrasts and add information on predictors whose existing evidence is either limited or mostly null/near-null. The next analysis should combine these targeted feature_065 coherence tests with the already registered deferred feature_042 and feature_045 panels. All conclusions remain dataset-specific association assessments; no causal or generalizable claims are supported by the current evidence.

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative: No claims are currently accepted, and the main active follow-up is the feature_065 coherence panel plus the newly active feature_042/feature_045 contrasts. To make the next analysis more informative, I registered a focused 12-test screen using two outcomes with the lowest relative clinical thresholds: outcome_014 (approximate threshold +0.0093) and outcome_006 (approximate threshold +0.0175). The selected predictor contrasts either had prior evidence worth completing or were reasonably balanced and largely untested on these low-threshold outcomes. Specifically, feature_048 level_003 versus level_001 is followed up because its outcome_009 estimate exceeded threshold but the feature_048 panel was otherwise discordant; feature_021 is followed up in the positive direction because its overall outcome_005 raw effect was positive with a confidence interval excluding null, although below threshold; feature_045 and feature_012 are followed up because adjacent outcomes produced near-threshold or unresolved signed estimates; feature_036 is followed up because outcome_015 was subthreshold but positive in the direction of stronger dependency; and feature_063 level_002 versus level_001 is included because it has large cell sizes and was not yet assessed on these outcomes. The purpose is coherence testing, not acceptance of isolated point estimates. A predictor will be considered for validation only if it shows threshold-relevant evidence on more than one low-threshold outcome or otherwise strong uncertainty evidence; otherwise the line should be closed. These remain dataset-specific association tests and do not support causal or generalizable claims.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative:
The new panel resolves most of the remaining screening leads and produces one standout result.

Feature_065: the coherence check failed. H138 on outcome_006 is near null and very wide; H139 on outcome_015 is positive and its interval excludes zero, but the estimate (0.0211) is below the approximate outcome_015 10% threshold (~0.025) and the interval still includes subthreshold effects; H140 on outcome_003 is opposite to the registered direction and its upper bound is well below the outcome_003 threshold (~0.025). Together with prior discordant feature_065 results, this does not justify validation, so I close the feature_065 line (H136, H138-H140).

Feature_048: H143 and H144 are uninformative or opposite-signed with wide intervals. They fail to cohere with the earlier isolated positive outcome_009 signal, and the feature_048 line is closed.

Feature_021: H145 on outcome_014 has a threshold-exceeding point estimate but an interval that includes null and subthreshold values, so it remains unresolved and active. H146 on outcome_006 is a major, precise, signed positive association: estimate 0.396, 95% CI 0.325 to 0.467. The outcome_006 10% threshold is approximately 0.0175, so the entire interval is far above threshold. The comparison has adequate cell sizes and is not subgroup-based. I accept H146 as a dataset-specific association: feature_021=1 is associated with much higher outcome_006 dependency scores (weaker dependency) than feature_021=0 within this dataset. Because this is a surprisingly large result after extensive multiplicity and has adjacent-outcome support only as a weak positive signal, I request independent validation. This is not a causal or generalizable claim yet.

Feature_012, feature_036, and feature_045: their new outcome_014/outcome_006 tests are discordant, opposite-signed, subthreshold, or too imprecise to support clinically meaningful associations. These lines are closed.

Overall, the only claim with strong evidence for clinical significance is H146. If validation confirms it, the feature_021 association can be retained; if validation weakens it, H146 and H145 should be reversed or closed. No causal mechanism or external generalizability is implied.

record.narrative:
Current final scientific report for this evidence state.

Supported finding: H146 is accepted as a dataset-specific association. For outcome_006, feature_021=1 versus feature_021=0 has a strongly positive mean difference: discovery estimate +0.396 with 95% interval +0.325 to +0.467, and independent validation estimate +0.435 with independent interval +0.334 to +0.536. Because more negative dependency scores mean stronger dependency, this means feature_021=1 is associated with substantially higher, i.e. weaker, dependency scores for outcome_006 within this dataset. The outcome_006 10% clinical threshold is approximately 0.0175, so both discovery and independent intervals lie far above a clinically meaningful threshold. This is the only claim in the current accepted set with robust threshold-level evidence.

Response deadline: H60 is reassessed using validation R102 and discovery R49. H60 tests feature_002=1 versus 0 on outcome_003 in the hypothesized lower direction; signed estimates near +0.004 correspond to a negligible mean difference. The outcome_003 10% threshold is approximately 0.025. The discovery upper bound +0.0195 already excluded a clinically meaningful effect, and the independent validation point is also tiny. The validation upper bound +0.0276 marginally crosses threshold because the independent interval is wide, but the combined evidence does not support a clinically meaningful difference. I keep H60 rejected and closed. Feature_002 remains largely negative for the tested outcomes and subgroups.

Negative findings: Broad screening produced many clinically small or null associations, and prior validation checks mostly failed to support threshold-level claims. Feature_065, feature_048, feature_012, feature_036, feature_045, and feature_002 have not produced a validated or coherent set of clinically meaningful associations across outcomes. The strongest earlier borderline leads were generally unstable across adjacent outcomes or subgroups and were not promoted.

Unresolved uncertainty: The feature_021 association is robust for outcome_006 but not yet resolved for other outcomes. H145 on outcome_014 has a point estimate +0.0157 that exceeds the low outcome_014 threshold of approximately 0.0093, but its interval +0.0247 lower to +0.0561 includes null and much smaller effects, so it remains unresolved and active. H14 on outcome_005 has a positive signed estimate +0.0201 with interval +0.0012 to +0.0390; it suggests positive association but is below the approximate 0.025 threshold and therefore is not accepted. I reopened H14 as active because it is the best existing coherence lead adjacent to the validated H146 result.

Most informative next analysis: Register a focused feature_021 coherence panel on additional outcomes with relatively favorable precision-to-threshold ratios: outcome_012, outcome_015, outcome_010, outcome_003, outcome_004, and outcome_013, all in the positive direction. This panel asks whether feature_021=1 is associated with higher dependency scores broadly across CRISPR dependency outcomes, or whether the very large H146 effect is outcome_006-specific. If several of these outcomes show threshold-exceeding positive estimates with intervals that exclude null and subthreshold values, the feature_021 line can be considered broadly supported in this dataset. If they are near null, wide, or subthreshold, the accepted scientific conclusion should remain narrow: feature_021 is strongly associated with outcome_006 but not with the other tested dependency outcomes.

All conclusions are dataset-specific associations only. The predictor labels are opaque, the design is observational, and multiple outcome/predictor comparisons were screened. Therefore no causal mechanism, biological interpretation, or external generalizability is claimed from the current evidence.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

record.narrative: Final scientific report for the current evidence state. H146 remains the only accepted dataset-specific association: feature_021=1 versus 0 is associated with a much higher, i.e. weaker, outcome_006 CRISPR dependency score. The discovery estimate is +0.396 with 95% interval +0.325 to +0.467, and independent validation is +0.435 with independent interval +0.334 to +0.536. The outcome_006 approximate 10% threshold is about 0.0175, so both discovery and validation intervals are far above a clinically meaningful threshold. This conclusion remains restricted to this dataset and does not imply causality or external generalizability. Newly delivered validation supports the robustness of H146 but fails to promote several earlier borderline leads. H77, feature_008=1 versus 0 on outcome_008 in the hypothesized stronger-dependency direction, had a discovery signed estimate +0.0322 with interval +0.0028 to +0.0617, but independent validation is only +0.0046 with interval -0.0416 to +0.0509. Against the outcome_008 threshold of about 0.028, this is not support for a clinically meaningful association, so H77 remains unresolved and closed. H55, feature_060=1 versus 0 on outcome_006, had discovery +0.0194 with interval including null and validation +0.0015 with interval including null and threshold-like effects; it also remains unresolved and closed as unsupported. H60, feature_002=1 versus 0 on outcome_003 in the hypothesized lower direction, is rejected: discovery and validation estimates are negligible, and although the validation upper bound slightly crosses threshold because of interval width, the combined evidence does not support a clinically meaningful difference. The feature_021 coherence panel is decisive in the negative direction for the broader question: outcome_006 is robustly associated with feature_021, but other dependency outcomes do not show threshold-level agreement. H155, H157, H158, H159, H161, and H164 are rejected because they are near null, opposite-signed, or below threshold; remaining feature_021 claims on outcomes 005, 014, 015, 013, 007, and 009 are at most subthreshold or uncertain and are closed. Thus the accepted inference is narrow: feature_021 is strongly associated with outcome_006, not with broadly lower dependency across the other CRISPR outcomes. Broad screening has produced many negative or near-null results: feature_002 main effects are null across many outcomes and validations; feature_008, feature_060, feature_065, feature_048, feature_019, and feature_012 have not produced a stable threshold-level pattern except the potential outcome_006 lead below. The most important unresolved lead is H125: feature_019 level_001 versus level_002 on outcome_006 in the registered negative/raw-more-negative direction has a signed estimate +0.0331 with interval -0.0084 to +0.0747. This crosses null and is therefore not accepted, but the point estimate is above the low outcome_006 threshold and this comparison may be confounded or attenuated by the very large feature_021 effect. I therefore kept H125 active for possible validation and registered a focused follow-up strategy: first, confirm H146 within feature_034 strata to assess internal consistency and heterogeneity of the accepted large effect; second, test the H125 feature_019 contrast within feature_021=0 and feature_021=1 strata to determine whether the potential feature_019 signal persists after stratifying by the dominant feature_021 driver. If those follow-ups yield intervals that exclude both null and subthreshold effects, a second dataset-specific association or a meaningful modifier of H146 could be supported. Otherwise the scientific conclusion remains that the only robust predictor-outcome association in this dataset is feature_021 with outcome_006, with all other predictor effects either unsupported, clinically small, or too uncertain to accept.

A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains

record.narrative: All due new results concern outcome_006 and are signed to the registered positive feature_021=1-minus-0 directions or the registered negative feature_019 level_001-vs-level_002 directions. Using the same operational 10% absolute-mean scale as previous assessments, the approximate clinically meaningful threshold for outcome_006 is about 0.0175. The accepted and validated H146 feature_021 effect is confirmed as internally consistent across major strata: H168 and H169 within both feature_034 strata, H173 and H174 within feature_019 levels 001 and 002, H177 within high complete log-PFS, and H179 within high observed feature_066 all have large positive signed estimates with lower confidence bounds far above threshold. These are accepted as dataset-specific stratum-specific associations, but closed to avoid over-allocating further follow-up on the same dominant feature_021/outcome_006 signal. The corresponding interactions H170, H178, and H181 do not support the registered positive modifier directions: their signed point estimates are negative or small and their confidence intervals include null and smaller effects, so they are left unresolved and closed. H171 rejects the simple negative feature_019 contrast within feature_021=0: the signed point is opposite the claimed direction and the upper bound is below threshold. H172 and H176 are the only potentially informative second signal: both suggest that the feature_019 contrast is much stronger in the feature_021=1 context than in feature_021=0. However, their lower confidence bounds fall at or just below the approximate threshold, and the small conditional cells plus multiplicity argue against acceptance without additional confirmation. H125's overall feature_019 main effect is therefore closed as unresolved: it is not robustly supported as a simple main association, and the stratified evidence makes its overall average interpretation unstable. No validation is requested now. H146 is already independently validated; validating borderline conditional interactions such as H176 would likely produce a stricter interval that is still too wide to separate threshold-level modification from null, while the robust strata are already internally coherent and the accepted overall effect is independently supported. All conclusions remain associations within this supplied dataset only, not causal or generalizable claims.

Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short

comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).

use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using

expectation

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative:
I assessed all newly delivered results under the same operational 10 percent rule used earlier: a clinically meaningful absolute mean difference is approximately 0.10 times the absolute overall outcome mean. For the outcomes examined here this is about 0.0256 for outcome_009, 0.0250 for outcome_015, 0.0250 for outcome_005, 0.0175 for outcome_006, and 0.0093 for outcome_014. All estimates and intervals were already signed to the registered hypothesis direction, and I did not multiply them again. The central conclusion remains unchanged: the only decisive, independently validated association is the very large feature_021 versus feature_021=0 effect on outcome_006 (H146); accepted stratum claims are coherent expressions of that same dataset-specific effect, not independent predictors.

The new conditional analyses did not produce a new clinically established association. H192 (outcome_009 feature_048 level_003 versus level_001, interaction by feature_019 level_002) has signed estimate +0.0283, with CI -0.0113 to +0.0680. The point estimate is near the outcome_009 threshold, but the interval includes both null and sub-threshold effects, and the interaction cells are smaller. This is not sufficient to claim effect modification, so I close it unresolved. H193 and H194 test whether the feature_065 contrast on outcome_015 is modified by, or present within, feature_021=1. H193 signed estimate is -0.0294, which is opposite the claimed negative interaction, and H194 in feature_021=1 is essentially null (signed -0.0023, wide interval). Together with R154 in feature_021=0, this pattern suggests the feature_065 signal, if real, is concentrated outside feature_021=1. I reject the negative interaction claim and the feature_021=1 association claim, while keeping H200 as a separate unresolved localization result. H195 (outcome_014 feature_065 interaction by feature_021=1) is positive in the claimed direction (+0.0579) but very imprecise and includes null; small conditional cells and multiplicity make acceptance inappropriate. H196 (outcome_005 feature_021 interaction by feature_019 level_002) has signed estimate +0.0165, below threshold and with CI crossing null, so I reject evidence of clinically meaningful modification. H197 tests whether feature_065 modifies the dominant feature_021 effect on outcome_006; the interaction is near zero (-0.0037), although the interval is wide. This provides no support for meaningful modification, though it does not prove absence because the interval includes large effects. I reject the modification claim as unsupported.

The most clinically relevant secondary signals are H198 and H200. H198 (outcome_009 feature_048 level_003 versus level_001 within feature_021=0) has signed estimate +0.0257, lower bound +0.0037. This excludes null but the lower bound is far below the threshold, so the data support a non-zero association but not a clinically established 10 percent effect. I keep it unresolved and close active follow-up on it. H200 (outcome_015 feature_065 within feature_019 level_002 and feature_021=0) has signed estimate +0.0326 with lower bound +0.0048. The point estimate exceeds threshold, but uncertainty includes substantial sub-threshold effects, so I do not accept it; it remains unresolved and is localized enough to merit one targeted interaction proposal. H199, within feature_021=0 on outcome_015, is below threshold and imprecise; I reject it. H201 is a very small, non-significant outcome_014 double-subgroup estimate; I reject it. H202 is positive but extremely wide (CI -0.0461 to +0.0755), and conditioning on higher log-PFS adds selection/collider concerns; I close it unresolved rather than accept. H204 is a broad screen with a near-zero signed estimate; I reject it.

Methodologically, the dominant feature_021/outcome_006 effect is so large that multiplicity is unlikely to explain it, but it could still be a technical or population-structure axis rather than a causal or generalizable predictor. The new secondary candidates are much more vulnerable to confounding by correlated predictors, small conditional cells, post-selection bias from many subgroup tests, and ambiguous clinical relevance when outcome means are near zero (especially outcome_014). I did not observe any obvious coding or analysis leakage: cells meet the Welch cell-size rule, estimates are signed as instructed, and predictors are treated as measured baseline variables. Conditioning on feature_024 is treated cautiously because clinical PFS could be correlated with downstream dependency biology and can induce selection effects in observational associations.

I requested no independent validation this iteration. H146 does not need further confirmation. The remaining near-threshold candidates (especially H198 and H200) would likely receive wider independent intervals that could not resolve whether the lower bound crosses the 10 percent threshold, and several other candidates are conditional interactions with wide intervals. Instead, I registered focused follow-ups: feature_048 on outcome_009 in the feature_021=1 stratum and its interaction with feature_021, to test whether the outcome_009 feature_048 signal is concentrated in the feature_021=0 complement, and a targeted interaction of feature_065 on outcome_015 by feature_019 level_002 within feature_021=0 to test whether H200 is localization rather than chance. All accepted or rejected conclusions remain associations in the supplied dataset, not causal claims or claims about external generalizability.

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction

and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are

record.narrative: No new validation releases or response deadlines were due in this synthesis, and the accepted evidence set is unchanged. The only scientifically decisive finding remains H146: feature_021 equals 1 versus 0 has a very large positive mean_difference on outcome_006. The independently validated estimate is about +0.435 with adjusted interval approximately +0.334 to +0.536, far exceeding the operational 10 percent threshold for outcome_006, about 0.0175 using one tenth of the absolute overall mean. Because more negative CRISPR dependency scores mean stronger dependency, this positive contrast means that feature_021 equals 1 is associated with substantially weaker outcome_006 dependency in this supplied dataset. The accepted stratum claims for outcome_006 and feature_021, including H168, H169, H173, H174, H177, H179, H180, and H182, should be read as conditional expressions of this same dominant dataset-specific effect, not as independent predictors. Negative evidence is broad and consistent: repeated comparisons involving feature_002 across many outcomes remained small and often tightly bounded near null; many common binary and categorical predictor contrasts also produced either small point estimates or intervals that failed to exclude the clinically relevant threshold. Independently validated borderline discoveries such as H77 and several closed unresolved claims illustrate that apparent borderline effects did not robustly survive validation or clear the 10 percent threshold. Unresolved uncertainty is concentrated in a small number of secondary, threshold-adjacent signals: H198, outcome_009 feature_048 level_003 versus level_001 within feature_021 equals 0, has signed estimate about +0.0257 with CI +0.0037 to +0.0477, but its lower bound is well below the outcome_009 threshold; H200, outcome_015 feature_065 within feature_019 level_002 and feature_021 equals 0, has signed estimate about +0.0326 with CI +0.0048 to +0.0604, again excluding null but not establishing a clinically meaningful 10 percent effect; H186, H190, H191, H192, and H195 remain analogous near-threshold or imprecise interaction candidates rather than supported associations. The most informative next analyses are the already registered localized tests H205, H206, and H207: H205 and H206 test whether the outcome_009 feature_048 signal is concentrated in or modified by feature_021 status, and H207 tests whether the outcome_015 feature_065 signal is localized to feature_019 level_002 within feature_021 equals 0. I deferred H203 because the feature_009 screen is less directly informative than the feature_048 and feature_065 localization tests. No additional independent validation was requested because the key accepted finding is already validated and the remaining borderline claims have discovery intervals whose lower bounds are below the threshold; validation intervals are wider and may not resolve the threshold question unless the true effect is substantially larger. All conclusions remain associations in the supplied dataset and should not be interpreted as causal or externally generalizable without external evidence.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative:
No assessments are due. The dominant validated finding remains the very large feature_021=1 versus feature_021=0 contrast on outcome_006; the registered active tests H205, H206, and H207 should be interpreted as localization/interaction checks around the only two residual threshold-adjacent secondary candidates: H198 for outcome_009 feature_048 and H200 for outcome_015 feature_065. The new proposals are designed to decide whether either candidate is a genuinely secondary association crossing an approximately 10 percent absolute-outcome-mean threshold, or merely a near-null signal localized by correlated feature_021/feature_019 structure.

For outcome_009 feature_048 level_003 versus level_001, the claimed direction is negative because prior estimates are consistent with raw level_003 scores being more negative than level_001, i.e. stronger dependency. The operational threshold is about 0.0256. Proposal 1 asks whether this contrast remains clinically relevant in the feature_021=0 population when further restricted to feature_019 level_002. Proposal 2 asks whether it remains relevant in feature_021=1 within feature_019 level_002. Proposal 3 asks whether a comparable contrast appears in feature_019 level_001 within feature_021=0, using level_001 as a practical proxy for the non-level_002 complement. Proposal 4 tests, among feature_021=0 observations, whether the level_003-minus-level_001 contrast is stronger in feature_019 level_002 than in its complement. The expected raw interaction is negative if feature_019 level_002 is the biologically relevant localizing stratum. Plausible alternatives are a null interaction if the feature_048 association is broad, an opposite interaction if level_002 attenuates the effect, or a null main contrast if the earlier H198 signal was driven by correlated feature_021 structure or post-selection.

For outcome_015 feature_065, the operational threshold is about 0.0250. Proposal 5 tests the complement of H200: feature_065=1 versus 0 within feature_019 level_002 but in the feature_021=1 population. If the H200 signal is genuinely tied to the feature_021=0 stratum, this comparison should be near null or opposite to the claimed negative direction. Proposal 6 tests whether the same feature_065 contrast appears in feature_019 level_001 within feature_021=0, using level_001 as a proxy for the non-level_002 complement. Proposal 7 tests the feature_019 level_002 interaction for feature_065 in the full population, which is more powerful than H207's feature_021=0 eligibility but may be diluted if feature_021=1 is null. The expected raw direction for feature_065 is negative in strata where dependency is stronger, but the anticipated raw direction is deliberately left uncertain for complement tests because localization is the scientific question. If any of these comparisons yields a signed lower bound above approximately 0.0250 for outcome_015 or 0.0256 for outcome_009, it would be eligible for acceptance; if it only excludes null but has a lower bound below that threshold, it should remain unresolved or be closed rather than accepted.

No independent validation is requested at this explore stage. H146 is already validated, while the secondary candidates are threshold-adjacent and have discovery intervals whose lower bounds fall below the 10 percent threshold; validation intervals are wider and may not resolve threshold crossing unless the underlying effect is much larger. All results will be interpreted as dataset-specific associations, not causal effects or externally generalizable claims.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct

references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation

record.narrative:
I assessed all newly delivered discovery results using the same operational 10 percent clinical-significance rule used previously: a mean difference is treated as clinically meaningful only when the signed point estimate is clearly above roughly one tenth of the absolute overall outcome mean and the confidence interval supports that threshold. For the outcomes in this batch the approximate thresholds are about 0.0256 for outcome_009, 0.0250 for outcome_015, 0.0415 for outcome_001, 0.0282 for outcome_008, and 0.0301 for outcome_011. All returned estimates and intervals are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction and were not re-signed. No new claim was accepted. The accepted evidence set therefore remains unchanged, with H146 still the only decisive, independently validated association: feature_021 equals 1 versus 0 has a very large positive mean_difference on outcome_006. The new results were mainly localization, stratum, and interaction checks around secondary candidates, and they do not establish a new clinically meaningful association.

For outcome_009 feature_048 level_003 versus level_001, the signal remains threshold-adjacent but uncertain. Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.

independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: All returned estimates and intervals were interpreted as already signed to the registered hypothesis direction. I applied the operational clinical-significance rule used throughout the run: accept only when the signed point estimate is clearly at least about 10 percent of the absolute overall outcome mean and the lower confidence bound also supports that threshold. The relevant approximate thresholds in this batch are 0.0093 for outcome_014, 0.0175 for outcome_006, 0.0250 for outcome_005 and outcome_015, and 0.0256 for outcome_009. No new claim crossed this stricter lower-bound threshold. The accepted decisive set therefore remains only H146, the very large feature_021 association with outcome_006. For outcome_014 and feature_021, H215 within feature_019 level_002 has signed estimate 0.0092, essentially at but not above the tiny outcome_014 threshold, with interval -0.0445 to 0.0628. H232 and H233 in feature_034 strata have positive signed estimates 0.0196 and 0.0114, both above the outcome_014 threshold in point estimate, but their lower bounds cross null and are far below threshold. H234 tests feature_034 interaction and is near null and imprecise. These results do not accept a clinically meaningful feature_021 effect on outcome_014 in the tested strata, but the intervals are too wide to support confident absence of a threshold-size effect, so I kept the mean-difference claims unresolved while closing this line as a low-priority near-threshold candidate. For the feature_034 main-effect screen, H217 on outcome_014 is near null and imprecise; H218 on outcome_006 is opposite direction but compatible with positive threshold; H225 on outcome_009 is below threshold with upper bound just above threshold; all are unresolved closed. H222 on outcome_005 has signed estimate -0.0102 and upper bound 0.0057, below the positive 0.025 threshold, so I reject a clinically meaningful positive feature_034 effect on outcome_005. H230 on outcome_015 is statistically significant in the opposite direction from the registered positive claim, but its magnitude is only about 0.017, below the 0.025 clinical threshold, so I reject the positive clinical claim while noting a subclinical opposite-direction association. For outcome_009 feature_048 level_003 versus level_001 in feature_034=1, H235 is the closest secondary candidate: signed estimate 0.0267, above the 0.0256 threshold, but the lower bound is about -0.0003, so it does not exclude null and certainly does not clear the clinical lower-bound rule. I keep it active and unresolved because it remains the most plausible remaining secondary signal. The feature_034 interaction H236 is small and inconclusive, so I closed it without accepting modification. For outcome_015 feature_065 in feature_034=1, H237 has signed estimate 0.0198 below the threshold and a wide interval crossing null, so it is unresolved closed. I did not request independent validation. The active H235 candidate could not be accepted on discovery lower-bound evidence, and an independent validation interval is much wider, making it unlikely to establish a clinically meaningful lower bound; validating subclinical or wide intervals for feature_034 main effects would also not help the stated clinical threshold. These conclusions remain dataset-specific associations and do not establish causality or generalizability. Caveats include post-selection subgroup exploration, many comparisons, and the unusually low threshold for outcome_014 due to its smaller absolute mean.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.
